newspaper.headline: Sale Season, Fake Email Season
newspaper.lead: As the month ends, office inboxes fill up with promos, bills, and announcements. Security experts remind everyone: not every urgent email is bad, and not every neat email is safe.

impact.good: Yesterday, Nusa Digital's new analyst stopped every phishing trap without blocking any work emails. Clients praised the careful work.
impact.mixed: Yesterday, most fake emails were stopped, but some got through or were blocked by mistake. The new analyst was asked to check senders more carefully.
impact.bad: Yesterday, several fake emails reached Nusa Digital employees. The SOC team is checking the damage and tightening its checks.

tip.title: Tip: Check the Sender's Address
tip.text: Anyone can type any display name. Look at the address after the @ sign, then compare it with the sender's official domain.

newspaper.classified: FOR SALE: Look-alike domains, cheap prices. Serious buyers only. — K.
